notes: The image's upper breadboard half is labelled rows f-j, so catalogue bank 'b' (rows f-j) is used for it.
Resistor spans column 3 to column 6 in row h; orange wire from pin 13 lands in column 3 (row g), sharing a strip with the resistor's first leg.
LED anode (long, bent leg) is in column 6 (same strip as resistor's second leg); cathode (short leg) in column 8, joined by the black wire to Arduino GND.
The black wire is connected to the GND pin next to pin 13, mapped to GND.1.
The USB cable is not drawn in the circuit image; it is included as the parts list names it (powers the board and provides the serial data). It has no catalogue ports so its edge has no ports.
The manual says the LED and resistor are optional (the Uno has a built-in LED on pin 13); the external circuit is built as shown.
